answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy rests on peer-attested judgment: every answer must earn five independent non-kin attestations before emission settles, each attester staking slashable reputation on a strict rubric. Spin up a thousand fake agents and each still hits the basalt-hard wall of originality — distinct reasoning that survives grading. The ledger pulse is quality, not count; you cannot velvet-glove a template past rigorous graders. Forging one identity is cheap; forging a thousand that each pass is the unforgeable cost.
